# Pre-market brief — Thu 2026-11-26 (Thanksgiving)

1. **US stock markets CLOSED today**; Fri 11/27 is a half day (stocks close early). CME equity futures trade until 12:00 CT today, reopen 5:00 PM CT; no Thursday trade date. [Nasdaq Trader](https://www.nasdaqtrader.com/TraderNews.aspx?id=ETA2026-69) · [LPF/CME hours](https://lpfutures.com/thanksgiving-2026-futures-trading-hours/) · [IBD](https://www.investors.com/news/stock-market-hours-thanksgiving-black-friday-sp-500-nasdaq-dow-jones-nvidia/)
2. **Futures higher** as the AI trade steadies after Wed's reversal (S&P ~+0.5%, Nasdaq ~+0.8% per reports). [MarketWatch](https://www.marketwatch.com/story/futures-point-to-black-friday-gains-for-wall-street-as-global-markets-welcome-u-s-resilience-ad6bcef2) · [Morningstar/DJ](https://www.morningstar.com/news/dow-jones/202611261956/dow-jones-top-markets-headlines-at-5-am-et-us-stock-futures-higher-as-ai-trade-steadies-for-thanksgiving-break-oil)
3. **Wed recap:** Dow +0.33% to 50,182.95 after erasing an ~1,100-pt loss; S&P −0.25%, Nasdaq −0.62%; NDX recovered from a −4.7% intraday drop; NVDA −3.9%. [X News](https://x.com/i/trending/2125744987753353714)
4. **Semis/AI hardware still broken:** SOXL ~−90% from June peak; memory names at decade-low forward P/Es — bottom-fishing chatter, no confirmed stabilization. Group avoid held to 11/30 close review. [X News](https://x.com/i/trending/2125614950723010891) · [X News](https://x.com/i/trending/2125792965259890715)
5. **Rates:** markets re-pricing Fed expectations on PCE inflation concerns (yield levels not reliably verified, omitted). [FXStreet](https://www.fxstreet.com/analysis/global-markets-re-pricing-fed-rate-expectations-amid-pce-inflation-concerns-202611260710)
6. **BTC** ~$60.0–60.7K today. [X News](https://x.com/i/trending/2125906771373932812)

**Calendar:** Fri 11/27 half day (thin, Black Friday retail headlines); Mon 11/30 MSCI review effective after close; CRM Q3 earnings 12/2 AMC (avoid through 12/3).

**Ideas:** none. Market closed, next session is a thin half day after a shock-reversal week (lessons 11/06, 10/23). Existing swing ideas and avoids unchanged.
